strategic_assertions.label: Atlas Logistics: logistics AI security pilot need
strategic_assertions.quote: Atlas Logistics needs a logistics AI security pilot for the Harbour initiative: evaluate prompt injection, access controls and audit logging before an October trial. The budget and purchase approval are not confirmed.

strategic_assertions.label: Harbour technical evaluator; no budget authority
strategic_assertions.quote: I am the technical evaluator for the Atlas Logistics Harbour AI security pilot; I have no budget authority and cannot approve a purchase.

strategic_assertions.label: Conditional logistics channel demo offer
strategic_assertions.quote: For Harbour I can offer a 30-minute logistics channel demo slot through Northline, provided we first receive a security brief and the partner opts in. This is not a commitment to introduce anyone or secure a customer.

strategic_assertions.label: Past warehouse access-control and audit logging rollout
strategic_assertions.quote: In 2025 I implemented warehouse access controls and audit logging for Atlas Logistics. That was a past delivery, not evidence that I have tested the current AI pilot.

strategic_assertions.label: Expired August warehouse security review request
strategic_assertions.quote: Atlas Logistics needed a warehouse security review for the August Harbour assessment. That request closed on 1 September 2026 and is no longer active.

strategic_assertions.label: Reported Northline vendor security evidence need
strategic_assertions.quote: Ben told me Northline needs vendor security evidence for the Harbour logistics AI pilot assessment. This is Northline's reported need, not my own, and I have not verified its budget or procurement timing.

strategic_assertions.label: No customer data in pilot before security review
strategic_assertions.quote: Atlas Logistics requires the Harbour AI pilot to use synthetic data until its security review is complete; no customer data is approved for this trial.
